    Subcategories, closure conditions and trivial morphisms #

    Basic API for the notions fixed in Statement.lean: subcategories (object properties closed under retracts, binary direct sums and zero objects), quotient-closed and submodule-closed (here: subobject-closed) subcategories (Definition 2.1), image-closed subcategories in an abelian category, the observation (2.1) that T ∩ F is image-closed when T is quotient-closed and F is subobject-closed, and the elementary behaviour of Z-trivial morphisms (Definition 2.2).
